text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш has won two G1 races at
Tokyo
Racecourse, but she responds
with a tense smile
when I compliment her
aptitude for Tokyo.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She recounts her experience of getting
hopelessly
lost in a train station the first
day she landed in
Japan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
